decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The existing porch and canopy structure are inconsistent with the character and appearance of the existing building; disrupt the design of this pair of semi-detached houses of which it forms part and on which they have an unbalancing effect and harm the street scene as a whole. The structures are not consistent with the Residential Extension Guidelines and are contrary to the Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Guidelines).

Condition : 2 - 2.	Although the loft extensions appear disproportionately large, the dimensions shown on the plans do not match the stated scale. The proposed set-ins and dimensions of the dormer's as scaled are smaller than the stated dimensions. The final appearance and bulk of the proposed extensions therefore cannot be accurately determined. The prevention of harm to the appearance and character of the building cannot be ensured, and as such the proposal would be contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations).

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposed side dormer is of an excessive and disproportionate scale. In combination with the location of the existing two-storey side extension it would result in a cluttered appearance as viewed from the side elevation, and from the street. The scale and design of the side dormer would be inconsistent with the Residential Extension Guidelines, as the dormer would not be secondary to the size of the roof face. This extension would therefore be contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations).

Condition : 4 - 4.	The resulting bulk and appearance of the building would over develop the site. The number of extensions would not have proportion or balance and would not complement the original building, or maintain the general street scene. The proposal would therefore be contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, side and rear roof extensions and retention of front porch and canopy to existing house.
